newsitem.title: SHARJAH: CRICKET-PAKISTAN WIN TOSS, OPT TO FIELD AGAINST NZ.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-PAKISTAN WIN TOSS, OPT TO FIELD AGAINST NZ.

text.p: won the toss and opted to field against New Zealand in the
Singer Champions' Trophy tournament on Wednesday.
Pakistan rested their skipper Wasim Akram who has a sore
shoulder and the team is being led by Saeed Anwar.
Pakistan - Saeed Anwar (captain), Aamir Sohail, Ijaz Ahmed,
Salim Malik, Hasan Raza, Shahid Afridi, Moin Khan, Saqlain
Mushtaq, Waqar Younis, Mushtaq Ahmed, Shahid Nazir.
New Zealand - Lee Germon (captain), Bryan Young, Nathan
Astle, Craig Spearman, Adam Parore, Chris Cairns, Mark
